beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The earlier arguments about signs now matter to strangers governed by shared records.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with Fire After the Herd and the decision still ahead.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Follow what Ar notices, and listen to what older people remember.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Keep track of the differences between a sign, a reason, and a story.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then watch those differences change when more people must live together.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This book suits readers who enjoy philosophical fiction with direct, spare language.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its questions grow larger while its words remain close to ordinary experience.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The invitation is to think carefully without pretending the path is complete.
